intro.lead: Hermes reads each channel's name and latest videos and suggests a folder.
intro.model_main: Uses your Hermes model ({model}), or the one you pick for this task
intro.model_unknown: Uses the model you set up in Hermes

steps.read: Hermes reads names and recent videos
steps.suggest: It suggests a folder (and tags) for each channel
steps.review: You review: nothing changes until you accept

group.tags_only: New tags (the folder stays the same)

row.folder_hint: Enter to keep · Esc to give up

partial.timeout: Time ran out before the end.
partial.batch: A batch didn't come back from the model, or Hermes wasn't sure.

uncovered.title_one: {count} channel without a folder isn't in these suggestions
uncovered.title_other: {count} channels without a folder aren't in these suggestions
uncovered.desc: They arrived after these suggestions were made, or the last run did not reach them.

notice.busy: An organization was already running, so you're following it.
notice.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was applied; suggestions that already arrived stay here for you to review.
notice.cancel_failed: Couldn't cancel; the work will finish on its own. Nothing changes until you accept.

nothing.title: Every channel already has a folder
nothing.desc: New subscriptions without a folder will show up here.

empty.title: No suggestions this time
empty.desc: Hermes didn't find a good folder for these channels.

no_model.title: Choose a model so Hermes can organize
no_model.desc: Hermes needs an AI model for this task. Pick one and sign in under Settings → Models, then come back and try again.

provider_unavailable.title: Hermes couldn't reach your AI model

ai.no_model_desc: Hermes needs an AI model to suggest folders. Pick one and sign in under Settings → Models first.
ai.provider_unavailable_title: Hermes couldn't reach your AI model
